business_summary: OFILM Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, research, development, production, and sale of optoelectronic products and technologies in Mainland China and internationally. It provides body electronics solutions; smartphone camera modules and lenses; and microelectronics comprising full-screen fingerprint solutions, optical sensing solutions, and WLO wafer level optics. The company also offers autonomous driving solutions comprising in-vehicle cameras and lenses, and ultrasonic and millimeter radars, as well as ADAS software algorithms, such as pure camera-based intelligent driving solutions, full millimeter radar automated parking solutions, and full-stack intelligent driving solutions that include cameras and radars, and sensory fusion solutions based on weakly supervised learning algorithms. In addition, it provides BCM/BGM, GW, RLS, seat memory modules, and other products; cockpit products, such as instrumentation, central control and duplex display screens, HUD, electronic rearview mirror, and in-vehicle infotainment system, etc., as well as intelligent cockpit system; IPC and robots; VR/AR field products, including optical lenses, image modules, optical machine modules, and complete assembly products; and sports and industrial cameras, and industrial and medical endoscopes. Further, it provides software and information technology; and technical services, as well as special equipment. OFILM Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as O-film Tech Co., Ltd. and changed its name to OFILM Group Co., Ltd. in March 2019. OFILM Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
